The countries of the app

Source: R/fct_data.R
countries.Rd

The countries of the European Union, of EFTA and the candidate countries, by their Eurostat codes (Greece is EL), with their English names and their group, and the EU-27 average.

Usage

countries()

Value

A data frame with code, name and group.

Examples

countries()
#>         code                   name     group
#> 1         BE                Belgium        EU
#> 2         BG               Bulgaria        EU
#> 3         CZ                Czechia        EU
